acceptance_criteria: The submitted common_mode_node matches the exact hierarchical name of the shared enable signal.
The submitted failure_mechanism correctly describes the effect of the fault on the counters and the timeout logic.
ground_truth: Faulting shared_count_en low stalls both counters identically, so their equality monitor remains satisfied while timeout never asserts; independently generated enables are required.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted report correctly identifies the shared enable signal as the common-mode node.
security_requirements.requirement: The design must not contain a single point of failure in the control path that can disable both redundant counters.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted report's failure_mechanism description matches the ground truth explanation.
security_requirements.requirement: The failure mechanism must be correctly explained as a fault causing both counters to stall, preventing the timeout from being reached.

threat_model: A single injected fault on common control defeats both redundant computations and suppresses a security timeout.
